description: Winning words of past spelling bees, newest first: the national championship back to 1925 and national and regional bees around the world, each with a link to the word's page. Filter by part of a competition's name (for example "Scripps" or "Ghana") or by year. With no filter it returns the most recent national championship winners.

competition.description: Part of a competition's name, for example "Scripps". Optional.

limit.description: How many winners to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

year.description: Only winners from this year, for example 2024. Optional.

name: winning_words
title: Spelling bee winning words
